en.html:
I pursued.

The wing armor groaned.
Every joint in my body screamed.

Let them.
I required only enough strength to deliver this sword one final time.

One stroke—
At that silver being.

en.html:
Too fast—
Too far!

What did it matter?
So long as I could see her form.
So long as I could see that silver.

I would pursue.
I would overtake her.

Seize those wings—
Drag her down—

And cut.
Cut her!

The silver silhouette reached the <ruby>farthest edge<rt>end</rt></ruby> of heaven.
I could no longer reach her—never.

A world for <ruby>one alone<rt>one alone</rt></ruby>. The palace of the moon.
She reigned upon that throne with a queen's nobility.

The warrior of silver sang one verse of <ruby>poetry<rt>poetry</rt></ruby>.
